title: Coordinate restriction induced by fixed signs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and assign a sign $z_i\in\{\pm1\}$ to each index outside $J$. Define a coordinate restriction on $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ by leaving every coordinate in $J$ free, fixing each coordinate outside $J$ to $+1$ when its assigned sign is $+1$, and fixing it to $-1$ otherwise.
